{{Vanilla|Bricks}}
{{Infobox auto}}
'''Bricks''' are a building block made of [[brick]]s. [[Matcha Flavoured]] doubles the recipe output and makes it reversible.

== Obtaining ==
{{Recipes}}
Four bricks make 2 blocks of bricks, where vanilla makes one; the vanilla recipe is removed.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/crafting/bricks.json}}</ref><ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/pack.mcmeta}}</ref> Two brick slabs craft back into a block.

=== Other sources ===
{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
{{Uses}}
Four blocks of bricks, 3 iron ingots and a kindling make an [[oven]]. A block of bricks crafts back into 2 bricks. Doubled brick slabs show a large-brick texture; see [[Large bricks]].
